mapper.sql: (s.end_dt IS NULL AND s.last_seen_dt > NOW() - (COALESCE((SELECT session_expire_mins FROM config LIMIT 1), 30) || ' minutes')::interval)
mapper.select:
SELECT s.login_session_id::TEXT AS row_id, s.member_id,
COALESCE(m.nickname, CONVERT_FROM(DECRYPT(DECODE(m.name,'HEX'),#{cryptoKey}::BYTEA,'AES'),'UTF8')) AS member_name, s.device_type, s.user_agent, s.login_dt, s.last_seen_dt, s.end_dt, s.end_reason, s.reg_ip, CASE WHEN THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS active_yn FROM login_session s LEFT JOIN member m ON m.member_id = s.member_id WHERE s.login_session_id = #{rowId}::integer
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_session (member_id, device_type, user_agent, login_dt, last_seen_dt, reg_ip) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{deviceType}, #{userAgent}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE login_session SET last_seen_dt = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND end_dt IS NULL
